acceptance_criteria: Every data exchange with the payroll system is recorded.
The record includes the cut-off period of the exchange.
The record includes the number of employees involved in the exchange.
The record includes the status of the exchange.
F-14ef95.statement: The system shall keep a record of every data exchange with the payroll system, including the cut-off period, the number of employees and the status of the exchange.

acceptance_criteria: Complete employee records of all employees are available in the system at go-live.
Current leave balances of all employees are available in the system at go-live.
F-196b8a.statement: The system shall have complete employee records and current leave balances of all employees available from the first day of live operation.

acceptance_criteria: System administrators can create user accounts.
System administrators can deactivate user accounts.
System administrators can reset user accounts.
System administrators can assign roles and branches to user accounts.
Employees who are separated lose system access on their separation date.
The System supports approximately 2 system administrators.
F-245e66.statement: The system shall allow system administrators to create, deactivate and reset user accounts and assign roles and branches, and employees who are separated shall lose access on their separation date.

acceptance_criteria: Employees can submit leave applications online specifying leave type, dates (whole or half day), and reason.
Employees can attach supporting documents when required, such as medical certificates for sick leave longer than two consecutive days.
Employees can cancel pending leave applications or request cancellation of approved ones.
Vacation leave applications must be filed at least three working days before the leave date.
Sick and emergency leave may be filed up to two working days after returning to work.
The system automates leave filing, approval, and balance computation.
F-317982.statement: The system shall enable employees to file leave applications online selecting leave type, dates (whole or half day), reason, and attach supporting documents if required, and allow cancellation of pending or approved leave applications.

acceptance_criteria: The system records employment movements such as regularisation, promotion, transfer, position change and separation with effective date and remarks.
Movement history for each employee is viewable in chronological order.
A movement updates the employee's current branch, position or status on its effective date.
Records of separated employees are retained for at least five years after separation.
F-3fa530.statement: The system shall record employment movements with effective date and remarks, show movement history in chronological order, update employee's current branch, position or status on effective date, and retain records of separated employees for at least five years after separation.

acceptance_criteria: The system supports up to 300 concurrent users.
Pages load within 3 seconds for 95% of requests under normal load.
The system achieves at least 99.5% monthly availability excluding scheduled maintenance.
F-45e9b0.statement: The system shall support 300 concurrent users, ensure pages load within 3 seconds for 95% of requests under normal load, and maintain at least 99.5% monthly availability excluding scheduled maintenance.

acceptance_criteria: Management users can view a dashboard with headcount by branch, department and employment status.
The dashboard displays new hires and separations, attrition rate, leave utilisation, absenteeism and tardiness rates, and overtime hours.
Users can filter the dashboard data by branch and by period.
The system supports approximately 10 management users accessing the dashboard.
F-477f50.statement: The system shall provide management with a dashboard showing headcount by branch, department and employment status; new hires and separations; attrition rate; leave utilisation; absenteeism and tardiness rates; and overtime hours, with filtering by branch and period.

acceptance_criteria: HR staff can create, update, and view regular and special non-working holidays in the holiday calendar.
The holiday calendar supports local holidays that apply only to specific branches.
When computing leave days, holidays are excluded from the count.
F-48d935.statement: The system shall allow HR staff to maintain a holiday calendar with regular and special non-working holidays including local holidays applying only to specific branches, and exclude holidays when counting leave days.

acceptance_criteria: The system disallows leave applications exceeding the available leave balance except for leave without pay.
Employees can file leave without pay even if their leave balance is insufficient.
Leave balance calculations consider approved leaves, accruals, carry-over, and conversions.
The system enforces leave balance rules consistently for all leave types except leave without pay.
F-4956da.statement: The system shall prevent filing leave beyond the available balance except for leave without pay.

acceptance_criteria: The System provides attendance, overtime, night differential and leave data to the payroll process.
Data is provided at the end of every payroll cut-off.
The interface does not require re-encoding by payroll staff.
F-4adcca.statement: The system shall provide the payroll system with each employee's approved attendance, overtime, night differential and leave data at the end of every payroll cut-off without requiring re-encoding by payroll staff.

acceptance_criteria: Access to the System is based on defined roles: employee, approver, branch HR officer, head office HR, management, and system administrator.
Branch HR officers can see only employees of their own branch.
Head office HR and management can see employees of all branches.
F-677f6e.statement: The system shall enforce role-based access control with roles for employee, approver, branch HR officer, head office HR, management, and system administrator, restricting branch HR officers to their own branch and allowing head office HR and management to see all branches.

acceptance_criteria: HR staff can generate reports for employee masterlist, leave balances and leave availed.
Reports include attendance summary, tardiness and absences, overtime summary, employment movements, and documents expiring.
Reports can be exported to Excel and PDF formats.
F-6bb40b.statement: The system shall allow HR staff to generate standard reports with export to Excel and PDF formats including employee masterlist, leave balances and leave availed, attendance summary, tardiness and absences, overtime summary, employment movements, and documents expiring.

acceptance_criteria: Employees can view their personal employee record.
Employees can submit change requests for personal information fields with supporting documents.
HR staff can approve or reject each personal data change request.
Approved changes update the employee record accordingly.
F-716f3a.statement: The system shall allow employees to view their own employee record and submit change requests for personal information including address, contact numbers, civil status, dependents, and emergency contacts with supporting documents, require HR staff to approve or reject each change request, and update the employee record upon approval.

acceptance_criteria: Attendance logs are imported into the system at least once per day from each branch's time-recording devices.
Branches with connectivity issues can manually upload attendance log files.
Attendance logs are matched to employees using their employee numbers.
F-76015c.statement: The system shall import attendance logs from time-recording devices at each branch at least once daily, allow manual upload of log files for branches with connectivity problems, and match logs to employees by employee number.

acceptance_criteria: Leave balances are computed automatically from credits, monthly accruals, approved leaves, carry-over, and conversions.
Employees can view their current leave balance per leave type.
HR staff can view current leave balances per leave type.
Both employees and HR staff can view the history of leave balance transactions.
F-769166.statement: The system shall compute leave balances automatically from credits, monthly accruals, approved leaves, carry-over and conversions, and display the current leave balance per leave type and the history of transactions to employees and HR staff.

acceptance_criteria: HR staff can upload and maintain employee documents such as contracts, government IDs, certificates, and clearances in PDF or image format up to 10 MB per file.
The system tracks documents that have expiry dates and lists those expiring within the next 30 days for HR staff.
HR staff receive reminders for documents expiring within 30 days.
F-9ce551.statement: The system shall enable HR staff to upload and maintain employee documents in PDF or image format up to 10 MB, track documents with expiry dates, and provide reminders for documents expiring within 30 days.

acceptance_criteria: HR staff can create, update, and view branches, departments, positions, and reporting lines.
Each employee record includes assignment to one branch, one department, one position, and one immediate supervisor.
Approval routing for requests is determined based on the organisation structure assignments.
F-ac009e.statement: The system shall allow HR staff to maintain the company's organisation structure including branches, departments, positions, and reporting lines, assign each employee to one branch, department, position, and immediate supervisor, and use the organisation structure to drive approval routing.

acceptance_criteria: HR staff and branch supervisors can create and maintain shift schedules and work rosters including fixed, rotating, and flexible shifts.
Rest days and schedule swaps can be managed within the shift schedules.
Shift schedules can be assigned individually to employees or to groups of employees.
Shift schedules can be uploaded into the system from a template file.
F-adf5f2.statement: The system shall enable HR staff and branch supervisors to maintain shift schedules and work rosters including fixed, rotating, and flexible shifts, rest days, and schedule swaps, assign schedules per employee or group, and upload schedules from a template.

acceptance_criteria: The system sends email notifications when requests are submitted, approved, rejected, or returned.
Approvers receive reminders for pending requests older than two working days.
HR staff receive reminders for documents expiring within 30 days.
F-b82a09.statement: The system shall send email notifications for submitted, approved, rejected and returned requests, send reminders to approvers with pending requests older than two working days, and send reminders to HR staff for documents expiring within 30 days.

acceptance_criteria: The system computes daily time records including hours worked, lates, undertime, absences, overtime hours, and night differential hours.
Approved leaves and holidays are taken into account in the daily time record computation.
HR staff can review and lock daily time records at each payroll cut-off.
Branch attendance logs are consolidated and daily time records are computed consistently across branches.
F-bfd6e9.statement: The system shall compute each employee's daily time record from attendance logs and schedules including hours worked, lates, undertime, absences, overtime, and night differential, considering approved leaves and holidays, and allow HR staff to review and lock daily time records each payroll cut-off.

acceptance_criteria: Employees can view their leave balances and leave history.
Employees can view their daily time records, overtime, and attendance corrections.
Employees can view their payslips for the last 12 months.
Self-service functions are accessible via mobile browsers for employees.
F-c302ae.statement: The system shall provide employees self-service access to view their leave balances, leave history, daily time records, overtime, attendance corrections, and payslips for the last 12 months, with payslips produced by the payroll system and accessible via mobile browsers.

acceptance_criteria: Employees can file correction requests specifying the reason for missed or wrong time entries.
Immediate supervisors can approve or reject attendance correction requests.
Approved corrections update the employee's daily time record accordingly.
F-dc5085.statement: The system shall allow employees to file attendance correction requests for missed or wrong time entries with a reason, require immediate supervisor approval, and update the daily time record once approved.

acceptance_criteria: Leave applications require approval first by the employee's immediate supervisor.
The department head acts as the final approver for leave applications.
Approvers can approve, reject, or return leave applications with remarks.
The system supports approximately 60 supervisors and department heads as approvers.
Leave applications shall follow a three-level approval including HR manager as a possible alternative.
F-ded973.statement: The system shall implement a two-level leave approval workflow where leave applications are approved first by the immediate supervisor and then by the department head as final approver, with approvers able to approve, reject or return applications with remarks.

acceptance_criteria: The system stores complete employee records including personal information, government IDs, contacts, dependents, education, employment status, position, branch, department, immediate supervisor, hire and regularisation dates.
HR staff can create, update, search and view employee records.
Changes to sensitive fields require HR approval before updating the record.
Approved personal data changes update the employee record.
The system provides a single, accurate source of employee information for head office and all branches.
The system supports approximately 15 HR staff users.
F-e38234.statement: The system shall maintain a complete employee record for every employee including personal and employment details, allow HR staff to create, update, search and view records, require HR approval for changes to sensitive fields, and update records upon approved personal data changes.

acceptance_criteria: Payslip data produced by the payroll system is imported into the System.
Employees can view their payslips within the System.
F-e4ffc4.statement: The system shall import payslip data produced by the payroll system so employees can view their payslips.

acceptance_criteria: HR staff can define leave types with their entitlement rules including annual credits, monthly accrual, eligibility after regularisation, maximum carry-over, and cash conversion of unused credits.
The system supports configuration of leave types: vacation, sick, emergency, maternity, paternity, solo parent, special leaves for women, and leave without pay.
Leave policies can be set differently based on the employee's employment status.
Configured leave types and policies are applied consistently in leave processing.
F-e776b5.statement: The system shall allow HR staff to configure leave types including vacation, sick, emergency, maternity, paternity, solo parent, special leaves for women, and leave without pay with entitlement rules such as annual credits, monthly accrual, eligibility after regularisation, maximum carry-over, and conversion of unused credits to cash at year-end, and support leave policies differing by employment status.

acceptance_criteria: Employees can file overtime requests either before or after performing overtime work.
Immediate supervisors approve or reject overtime requests.
Only approved overtime is included in the daily time record.
Overtime exceeding four hours on a working day requires prior approval.
F-ec1e6d.statement: The system shall allow employees to file overtime requests before or after rendering overtime, require immediate supervisor approval, count only approved overtime in daily time records, and require prior approval for overtime exceeding four hours on a working day.

acceptance_criteria: Employees can submit certificate of employment requests specifying the purpose.
HR staff can approve or reject certificate of employment requests.
Upon approval, the system generates a PDF certificate using a company template with the employee's details.
Employees can download the generated certificate PDF from the system.
F-f2256e.statement: The system shall allow employees to request a certificate of employment stating the purpose, require HR staff to approve the requests, and generate the certificate as a PDF from a company template with the employee's details for employee download.

acceptance_criteria: Every creation, update, deletion, approval and login is recorded with user, date and time.
The values before and after each change are recorded.
HR managers can search the audit trail by user.
HR managers can search the audit trail by employee.
HR managers can search the audit trail by date range.
F-fd2b6c.statement: The system shall record every creation, update, deletion, approval and login with user, date/time, and values before and after change, and HR managers shall be able to search the audit trail by user, employee and date range.

actors.description: Company employees who use self-service functions to access and request HR information.
actors.name: Employees

actors.description: Approvers who review and approve leave and overtime requests.
actors.name: Supervisors and department heads

actors.description: Head office and branch HR officers who manage employee records, approvals, and reports.
actors.name: HR staff

actors.description: Users who access dashboards and reports for workforce insights.
actors.name: Management

actors.description: Administrators who manage user accounts, roles, and system settings.
actors.name: System administrators

actors.description: External system that receives attendance and leave data and provides payslip data.
actors.name: Payroll system

business_rules.text: Changes to sensitive employee record fields require HR approval.
Leave policies may differ by employment status.
Employees must attach supporting documents for sick leave longer than two consecutive days.
Leave applications require two levels of approval: immediate supervisor and department head.
The System shall prevent filing leave beyond available balance except for leave without pay.
Holidays are excluded when counting leave days.
Attendance logs must be matched to employees by employee number.
Overtime requests must be approved by the immediate supervisor to be counted.
Attendance correction requests require immediate supervisor approval and update daily time records once approved.
HR staff shall approve or reject employee personal data change requests; approved changes update records.
Leave applications follow a three-level approval: immediate supervisor, department head, and HR manager.
Vacation leave must be filed at least three working days before the leave date.
Sick and emergency leave may be filed up to two working days after returning to work.
Overtime exceeding four hours on a working day requires prior approval.
Records of separated employees shall be retained for at least five years after separation.
Employees who are separated lose system access on their separation date.

constraints.text: The contract shall be fixed price, inclusive of all professional fees for the scope of this TOR.
The System shall be delivered, accepted and in live operation within five months from the issuance of the Notice to Proceed.
Ten percent of the contract price is payable upon contract signing.
Ninety percent of the contract price is payable upon final acceptance of the System.
Final acceptance requires successful user acceptance testing and one month of live operation without critical defects.
The vendor shall provide a six-month warranty after final acceptance covering defect correction at no additional cost.
Proposals will be evaluated on technical merit (70%) and price (30%).
Payroll computation, withholding tax and statutory contribution processing remain in the existing payroll system and are out of scope.
Recruitment, learning management and performance appraisal modules are out of scope.
Cloud subscription fees after turnover will be paid by the Company.
The Company shall assign a product owner from HR.

nfrs.text: The System shall be accessible through current versions of common web browsers on desktop and mobile devices.
The System shall be deployed on a public cloud platform with daily backups retained for 30 days.
The System shall support 300 concurrent users.
Pages shall load within 3 seconds for 95% of requests under normal load.
The System shall have at least 99.5% monthly availability, excluding scheduled maintenance.
The System shall be secure, user-friendly and scalable to support future growth.
Data shall be encrypted in transit and at rest.
